atomic_facts.fact: The company's legal name is SIGNA Holding GmbH.
Its Firmenbuch registration number is FN 191343m.
Its registered office is Maria-Theresien-Straße 31, 6020 Innsbruck, Austria.
René Benko is chairman of the Advisory Board of Signa Holding GmbH.
René Benko is the controlling (majority) shareholder of Signa Holding GmbH.
Signa Holding GmbH is Austria's largest privately owned real estate company.
Signa is engaged in real estate development and investment.
Signa Holding GmbH announced insolvency proceedings at the end of November 2023.
Signa Holding applied for self-administration and restructuring at the Vienna Commercial Court.
On 11 April 2024 the Handelsgericht Wien changed Signa Holding GmbH's proceedings into a Konkursverfahren (bankruptcy liquidation).
The proceedings had previously been a Sanierungsverfahren (restructuring proceedings) opened on 29 November 2023.
As of 2026-10-01, Signa Holding GmbH's insolvency proceedings remain ongoing.
An insolvency plan obliged parent company Signa to contribute €200 million (to Galeria's rehabilitation).
A large portion of that €200 million contribution has not yet been paid.
Only a small fraction of the claims (about €80.3 million) had been recognized by the insolvency administrator.
